about.missionText: From set design to artistic editing, Kinnov'art puts its five crafts to work for creative youth across Guinea.

home.heroSubtitle: Based in Nongo at the Maison des Jeunes, Kinnov'art builds sets, furniture and productions for Guinean creative talent.
home.brandIntro: Kinnov'art is a company specialised in set design, furniture made from used tyres, the layout of private and public spaces, event decoration, artistic production and management, as well as a range of related services. Our experience in adding value to recycled materials lets us develop creative solutions that are at once economical, aesthetic and environmentally friendly.

Everything came together: the set, the lighting and the editing. The video speaks for itself.
They turned a simple idea into a memorable video. Thanks to the whole team.
The result exceeded my expectations. Kinnov’art is serious and creative work.
A clean video, delivered on time, with a real artistic direction.
The team staged our kiosks with remarkable creativity.
A team that listens and respects the artist’s world from start to finish.
With several of us on the track, everyone found their place in a coherent video.

testimonials.quote: The production captured the energy of the song and translated it on screen.

aboutContent.historyP1: Founded in 2020 in the heart of Nongo, Kinnov'art grew out of a shared passion for local craftsmanship and digital innovation. What started as a small carpentry workshop quickly became a multidisciplinary creative centre.
aboutContent.historyP2: Over the years we broadened our horizons to include audiovisual production, artist management and events, becoming a pillar of Conakry's cultural scene.
aboutContent.missionP: Our mission is twofold: to showcase Guinean craftsmanship through modern creations, and to give young talent a platform for expression.
aboutContent.missionInnovationText: Push the boundaries of local creation.
aboutContent.missionTrainingText: Pass skills on to the next generation.
aboutContent.missionCollaborationText: Build synergies between artists from every background.
aboutContent.teamIntro: A passionate, diverse team united by a shared will to create and innovate.
